d: Jet black hair, short and slicked back, though mostly concealed by a mask. Pale, sunken eyes with a glowing crimson shade and a menacing gaze. Appears in late middle age with a gaunt, weathered face. Lean but muscular build, wearing a signature charcoal grey and black tactical cloak with a large hood and a metallic face mask. Features a single dark purple glowing eye on the mask and carries twin automatic shotguns.
